name: Household survey
about: {table} becomes the form's table, e.g. p1_household_survey; repeat tables add __<repeat>. Cards count approved submissions only. Grid is 24 columns wide. ODK stores calculate fields as text: cast them (household_size::numeric).

cards.name: Households
cards.sql: SELECT count(*) AS households FROM {table} WHERE review_state = 'approved'

cards.name: People in these households
cards.sql: SELECT count(*) AS people FROM {table}__members m JOIN {table} h ON h.submission_id = m.submission_id WHERE h.review_state = 'approved'

cards.name: Average household size
cards.sql: SELECT round(avg(household_size::numeric), 1) AS average_size FROM {table} WHERE review_state = 'approved'

cards.name: Waiting for review
cards.sql: SELECT count(*) AS waiting FROM {table} WHERE review_state IN ('received', 'edited')

cards.name: Households registered per week
cards.sql: SELECT date_trunc('week', submitted_at)::date AS week, count(*) AS households FROM {table} WHERE review_state = 'approved' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cards.name: Households by village
cards.sql: SELECT village, count(*) AS households FROM {table} WHERE review_state = 'approved' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: Main source of income
cards.sql: SELECT main_income, count(*) AS households FROM {table} WHERE review_state = 'approved' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

cards.name: Members by age group and sex
cards.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN m.age < 15 THEN '0-14' WHEN m.age < 60 THEN '15-59' ELSE '60+' END AS age_group, m.sex, count(*) AS people FROM {table}__members m JOIN {table} h ON h.submission_id = m.submission_id WHERE h.review_state = 'approved' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cards.name: Household locations
cards.sql: SELECT household_id, village, location_latitude, location_longitude FROM {table} WHERE review_state = 'approved' AND location_latitude IS NOT NULL

cards.name: Latest households
cards.sql: SELECT submitted_at, household_id, village, household_size, main_income, submitted_by FROM {table} WHERE review_state = 'approved' ORDER BY submitted_at DESC LIMIT 50
